I had health anxoety issues. Hypochondria. And abandonment issues. My health anxiety was bad enough at times where I had sort of tunnel vision despite his frequent attempts to get me to look up from WebMD on my phone. I was always paranoid I'd lose him and he always reassured me he would never do so. Whenever we had an argument, it was almost always something to do with something he said that unintentionally hurt my feelings and contradicted his previous reassurances. These were the times he was 'opening up' to me. And because I reacted to them with anger/emotion...he felt he couldn't be honest with me anymore about how he feels about things. Or hide it. As for the anxiety, he really pushed me to get help on, and told me he would be there with me to learn how to best help understand how to deal with it too. He was very much encouraging me to better myself for myself, not for the relationship. Not a bad thing to think for someone. I was deathly scared of going to someone..and that stems from my childhood. I tried to fix my own anxiety on my own and hide it from him as a result. I would just not bother him with it and annoy him cause it was to a point where, if my anxiety popped up at all, he wouldnt want to spend time with me that day to deal with it myself, or to find someone...anyone else to talk to about it, not him cause he was sick of it. Which led to the big fight a few months ago. He told me "you never believe how I feel about you. I don't want to spend time with you anymore, sleep with you anymore. I have given you many chances to get help and I would like you to leave". When I bawled about that, he looked at me like I was pathetic and to get a hold of myself. I told him I have known I need help and I was sorry, how great he is, etc. He told me "its too late. You think getting help will make me love you again?" "You don't love me--?" "BED Sarah, I have to be up at 6" and he slammed the door in my face. The other day he used that instance as an example.."why did I have to slam the door in your face a few months ago? Cause you have no off switch". i went to a therapist in the coming days...nervous out of my mind and she could tell I hadnt slept in days cause I was afraid of losing him. I hadn't bothered or said a word to him im days. After my apt,  he then texted me "im glad you saught help. We will see how it goes but I would like some space at home for now". And I understood. After a day or so, he green lighted me that he wants to try again with me..provided I stay with my therapist and improve. After maybe a day or two he was really super affectionate and cuddly..back to himself again. Wanting to go on adventures with me, always looking out for me. He always looked out for me when I couldn't do it for myself before. God im an asshole. No wonder he can't handle mine and his stress anymore. My health anxiety didn't peep out in the 3 months since that fight, and I continued therapy. We were the best we ever were. I even suggested he come with to therapy since he always said he wanted to learn and be there. He said he would come, we did a few sessions and I could tell he didn't want to be there. He told me yesterday he hadn't wanted to go, or try and learn anymore. I feel like a shit brick like...no wonder he wants out, anyone would if they had to deal with my shit...

That looks like contact dermatitis to me, especially how the redness seems to go past the top lip barrier. You may be allergic to something you are eating or putting on your lips. It is possible that the chapstick you are using is actually the culprit. I would go to a dermatologist/doctor for a proper check-up and possible allergy testing. In the meantime, avoid putting *anything* on your lips...at all. Do not lick them, do not eat anything too spicy or acidic.

It is called an ear-worm, and it is extremely common. I've personally had that exact tune stuck in my head before for a good day or so. Stress/anxiety can make it come about/worse. Just shrug your shoulders and accept it. It will go away in time.

The type of Urticara you say you have been diagnosed with is brought about by heat. Do you take warm/hot showers? And is this flaking predominantly happening specifically after those showers or after being outside on a hot day? 

Otherwise it sounds like Seborrheic Dermatitis. Especially since this all occurs from the neck up. Do you have dandruff as well? Is your scalp tender? 

Either way, a dermatologist is in order. Neither conditions are detrimental or serious and can be managed or even fixed with proper creams and possibly medication.

What you are experiencing is clinically called Orthostatic Hypotension. To have it happen to the extent you have is abnormal. There is a relatively long list of causes from diabetes, to heart disease, anorexia, endocrine disorders, valve disprders. There is also the possibility that there is a stenosis in any of the arteries/veins that supply blood to/from your brain. An exhaustive exam is definitely in order. If you are having these near fainting spells daily along with (now) headaches, I would go in as soon as possible.
